covers.prompt: Portrait 600x800 book cover art, cinematic oil painting with restrained brushwork. A Chinese woman in her early thirties stands in a dim futuristic identity verification room, shown in three-quarter profile, holding a cracked transparent memory storage shard near her chest. Opposite her stands a Chinese man with the same age and familiar posture, slightly blurred as if reconstructed from memory. Between them floats a thin holographic biometric ring broken at one point, suggesting an interrupted first-person memory chain. Their faces are not identical, but their expressions carry intimate recognition and devastating doubt. A cold examination table, discarded legal documents, and a faint countdown reflection appear in the background without readable text. Leave the upper left third relatively dark and uncluttered for title typography. Sophisticated Chinese bookstore sci-fi aesthetic, realistic human anatomy, cinematic rim light, subtle film grain, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no seal, no watermark.

covers.prompt: Portrait 600x800 vertical book cover illustration in expressive black-and-white woodcut print style, dense carved textures and sharp crosshatching. A woman memory forensic expert sits at a courtroom-like desk, one hand covering a missing section of a long strip of film, while a man stands behind the strip like a figure cut out of several overlapping identities. Three deliberate knocks are represented by three small circular dents on the wooden desk, not as symbols or text. In the background, a towering mechanical archive cabinet opens like a coffin, releasing strips of film that curl around both figures and terminate before their faces. The composition should feel intelligent, severe, and slightly darkly comic, with a tiny muted vermilion accent on a warning light. Keep the upper right quarter mostly pale and empty for title typography. No readable writing, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no seal, no watermark, no modern glossy effects.

covers.prompt: Portrait 600x800 conceptual cyber-neon photographic artwork, minimalist composition with strong negative space. Two Chinese wedding rings rest on opposite sides of a transparent biometric scanner, connected by a thin glowing memory waveform that breaks in the center. Behind the scanner, only the reflected silhouettes of a woman and a man are visible, but their reflections face each other differently from their real bodies, creating a subtle identity paradox. A small bedside table with three faint impact marks and one empty chair suggest shared domestic life without showing a literal scene. Wet glass, midnight city lights, shallow depth of field, sleek near-future technology, emotionally restrained rather than action-oriented. Leave the top half mostly black with a soft gradient for title typography. Premium Chinese literary sci-fi cover mood, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no seal, no watermark, no decorative interface clutter.
